default.notes: Eligible for the Indian eVisa — apply online at least four days before travel; tourist eVisas are issued for 30 days, 1 year or 5 years.

groups.notes: Not on the eVisa eligibility list — apply for a regular visa through an Indian mission; confirm current eligibility on the official portal.

IN.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Indian citizens.

NP.notes: No visa needed: under the 1950 India–Nepal treaty the border is open, and Nepali citizens may enter, live and work in India with an accepted identity document — no stay limit.

BT.notes: No visa needed: under the India–Bhutan friendship arrangements the border is open, and Bhutanese citizens may enter, live and work in India with an accepted identity document — no stay limit.

MV.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days under the India–Maldives bilateral agreement.
